questions.q_en: Your forecast beats persistence by 41 percent at two hours, but you say most of the run sits above the range where OD is linear in cell count. So you are forecasting the photometer reading. Why is that useful?
questions.q_zh: 你們的預測在兩小時尺度上比 persistence 好 41%，但你們自己說大部分的實驗都在 OD 與細胞數不成線性的範圍之上。所以你們預測的是光度計讀值。那這有什麼用？
kw_en: the control loop acts on the reading
all five models forecast the same signal
kw_zh: 控制迴路用的就是讀值
五個模型預測的是同一個訊號
questions.a_en: Because the decisions it feeds are made on the reading, not on a cell count: when to harvest, when to feed, when to switch the light, and whether the instrument is still telling the truth. For those, a two-hour forecast with an RMSE of 0.040 against 0.067 for persistence is directly useful, and the gain survives to twelve hours at 0.310 against 0.373. The ranking is also unaffected by the non-linearity, because all five models forecast the same signal, so the comparison is fair even where the signal is not proportional to biomass. What we cannot do is call it a biomass forecast — converting optical density into cell counts needs a calibration against plate counts that we have not run, and the page states that limit next to the result.
questions.a_zh: 因為它餵的那些決策本來就是用讀值做的：什麼時候採收、什麼時候補料、什麼時候切燈，以及儀器還有沒有在講實話。對這些來說，兩小時 RMSE 0.040 對 persistence 的 0.067 是直接有用的，而且這個優勢撐到十二小時，0.310 對 0.373。非線性也不影響排名，因為五個模型預測的是同一個訊號，所以即使訊號跟生物量不成比例，比較仍然是公平的。我們不能做的是把它叫成生物量預測——把光密度換成細胞數需要對塗盤計數做校正，而那個校正我們沒做，頁面上也把這個限制寫在結果旁邊。
questions.trap_en: Defending it as a growth forecast. Say what the loop actually acts on, and that the cell-count conversion has not been done.
questions.trap_zh: 把它當成生長預測來辯護。要講清楚控制迴路實際作用在什麼上面，以及細胞數的換算還沒做。

questions.q_en: You registered three endpoints on 1 October. One passed and two were not scored. Is reporting the one that passed not exactly what pre-registration is supposed to prevent?
questions.q_zh: 你們 10 月 1 日登記了三個指標，一個通過、兩個未評分。只報通過的那一個，不正是預先登記本來要防止的事嗎？
kw_en: the two were unscorable when written
no cross-calibration to the inline cuvette
the primary has its own boundary
kw_zh: 那兩個在登記時就無法評分
與線上流通池沒有互校
主要指標自己也有邊界
questions.a_en: It would be, if the two had been dropped after we saw the data — they were declared unscorable in the registration itself, for the reason that both depend on plate-reader quantities with no cross-calibration to the inline cuvette, and that sentence was written before the run. What was scored is the primary endpoint: a specific growth rate of 0.2986 per hour with a 90 percent interval of 0.2705 to 0.3300, against an observed 0.286 plus or minus 0.010 thirteen days later in a one-litre perfusion loop. I would rather volunteer the boundary on that than defend it: the fit runs over five hours in which a straight line describes the readings as well as an exponential does, so the rate comes from a stretch where the two shapes cannot be told apart. The same pre-registration discipline is why the algorithm study reports all eight predictions including the five that failed.
questions.a_zh: 如果那兩個是在看到數據之後才被拿掉，那就會是——但它們在登記文件本身就被宣告為無法評分，理由是兩者都依賴盤式讀值、而盤式讀值和線上流通池之間沒有互校，而那句話是在實驗之前寫的。被評分的是主要指標：比生長速率 0.2986 每小時、90% 區間 0.2705 到 0.3300，對上十三天後在一公升灌流迴路裡觀測到的 0.286 ± 0.010。這一點的邊界我寧願自己講出來而不是替它辯護：那個擬合只跑五小時，在那段時間裡直線和指數同樣能描述讀值，所以速率來自一段分不出兩種形狀的區間。同樣的預先登記紀律，也是演算法研究把八個預測全部報出來、包括失敗的五個的原因。
questions.trap_en: Getting defensive. The answer is that the exclusion was pre-dated and written down, and then volunteering the limit of the endpoint that did pass.
questions.trap_zh: 變得防衛。答案是「那個排除是事前寫下來的」，然後主動講出通過那個指標自己的限制。

questions.q_en: Your model says heat adds nothing to the second-crop stress index once wind, light and badly timed water are in. That does not support your wet lab's heat programme. Who is right?
questions.q_zh: 你們的模型說，當風、光和時機不對的水分都放進去之後，熱對第二期作的逆境指數沒有額外貢獻。這並不支持濕實驗室的熱逆境計畫。誰對？
kw_zh: 縣級產量 vs 單株生理
改變的是優先順序不是有效性
questions.a_en: Both are right about different questions, and the page says the disagreement out loud rather than hiding it. The model asks which weather terms reduce county-level rice yield error over twenty-five years, and heat drops out of the second crop once wind, radiation and badly timed water are in; the wet lab asks whether a protectant changes how one Arabidopsis plant survives 37 degrees, and it does. So the model is not saying heat is harmless to a plant, it is saying heat is not the limiting economic signal in that crop and that season. What it changes is priority: if we had another season of wet-lab time, the model would send it to salinity and to water timing before heat, and that is the kind of redirection we want a model for.
questions.a_zh: 兩邊各自回答不同的問題，而頁面把這個不一致明講出來，沒有藏起來。模型問的是「哪些天氣項能降低二十五年來縣級稻作產量的預測誤差」，而在風、輻射和時機不對的水分都放進去之後，熱在第二期作就掉出來了；濕實驗室問的是「保護蛋白會不會改變單株阿拉伯芥在 37 度下的存活」，而答案是會。所以模型沒有說熱對植物無害，它說的是「在那個作物、那個季節裡，熱不是限制性的經濟訊號」。它改變的是優先順序：如果我們還有一季的濕實驗室時間，模型會建議先投到鹽度和水分時機，而不是熱——而這正是我們要一個模型來做的事。
questions.trap_en: Choosing a side. The useful answer separates the economic signal from the physiological one and then says what the model would reprioritise.
questions.trap_zh: 選一邊站。有價值的答案是把經濟訊號和生理訊號分開，然後說模型會把優先順序改成什麼。
